pages.text: A race's armour shards and sticks make its pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, as iron ones are made; five shards round an iron ingot make its shield. All are of iron's level and mended with the race's shards.$(br2)$(l)Zerg$() (250 uses): living chitin mends itself, a use every 10 s, three times as fast on creep. The axe bites wood a little faster, the shovel digs creep fast, the hoe makes soil that never dries, the sword poisons one blow in five.

$(l)Terrans$() (375 uses): plain steel, half again as tough; the terran shield held takes blasts better (60 % of their damage).$(br2)$(l)Protoss$() (250 uses): an energy shield takes the first 30 wears of the tool; 30 s after the last it is whole again.

Two shards, as shears are made, make a race's $(l)repair tool$(): it mends a quarter of a block's kept damage a use. The terran one mends what is mechanical (terran armour, metal), the zerg mender what lives (zerg armour, flesh, creep, wood, wool, bone), the protoss restorer brings protoss blocks' shields back.
